crucialFeats: Picks up and slams down a Y-Wing bomber.
Slams two starships together with telekinesis.
Impales himself to kill the reborn Darth Maul.
Blocks an energy blast with his hand.
Survives a giant explosion that destroys a casino.

dossier.advantage: Elite precision and an iron defense. His mastery of the Force allows him to control the environment and the enemy's body, preventing effective counterattacks.
dossier.mentality: Cold, patient, and ruthless. He waits for the smallest mistake from the opponent to end the fight with a single, vengeful strike.
dossier.quote: All I am surrounded by is fear. And dead men.
dossier.style: Technical pressure fighting with the Force. He combines perfect lightsaber swordsmanship with brutal telekinesis to choke and crush opponents in close quarters.

fighterA.name: Darth Vader

powers: Force telekinesis, precognition, choke and crush techniques, and elite lightsaber lethality.
tools: Defensive saber discipline, blaster and energy deflection, and Force-based battlefield control.
weaknesses: Cybernetic life-support dependence and vulnerability to sustained system disruption.
Lower raw physical durability and scale than top cosmic entities.

crucialFeats: Destroys a planet during a fight with Drax.
Walks out of a gas-giant explosion unharmed.

dossier.advantage: Near-absolute invulnerability and tactical genius. He possesses a body capable of surviving attacks from gods and a mind that instantly turns an enemy's mistake into their inevitable defeat.
dossier.mentality: Arrogant nihilist with iron discipline. He fights with absolute certainty of his superiority, seeking to ruthlessly crush anyone who stands in his way.
dossier.quote: I did not force you to fight me. You forced me into doing what I did. I had to be faithful to my nature. For, after all, I am Thanos.
dossier.style: Brutal, precise powerhouse combat. Thanos combines mastery of hand-to-hand combat with devastating cosmic energy blasts to systematically crush any defense.

fighterB.name: Thanos

powers: Massive strength and durability, cosmic energy projection, force fields, and matter manipulation.
tools: Strategic intellect, combat adaptability, and broad resistance profile.
weaknesses: Arrogance and tendency to test opponents can create early openings.
Without Infinity Stones, he remains elite but lacks Gauntlet-level instant authority.

victories: Beta Ray Bill and Ronan the Accuser

battle-dynamics.label: Ultimate Inevitability
battle-dynamics.phase_1: Vader strikes with Force fury, attempting to impose his will on a cosmic being. Thanos receives the attacks with ironic calm.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: Lightsaber and telekinesis clash with physical invulnerability. Thanos's scale begins to overwhelm the Sith Lord's systems.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: End of hope. Every atom of space belongs to Thanos. Vader is reduced to an insignificant anomaly.
battle-dynamics.analysis: In this clash of two powers, there are no variables that could change the outcome. Thanos dominates in every dimension of physics.

fight-simulation.label: Final Verdict
fight-simulation.opening: Vader opens the fight with a Force charge, attempting to immediately crush Thanos's helmet.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: Thanos simply grabs the lightsaber blade, ignoring the plasma's heat and energy.
fight-simulation.late_fight: Thanos ends the clash with a single, precise strike that destroys Vader's cybernetics.
fight-simulation.end_condition: Thanos's victory by absolute scale advantage.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Vader strikes with all his hate, but Thanos does not even flinch under the telekinetic pressure.
fight-simulation.phase_2_event: The lightsaber cuts through Thanos's armor, without leaving even a scratch.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_a: Vader attempts to use Force Crush on Thanos's heart.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_b: Thanos smiles and counterattacks with a cosmic blast.
fight-simulation.phase_3_event: Thanos systematically destroys every life-support mechanism of Vader.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_a: Vader falls, losing touch with the Force.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_b: Vader's armor cracks under the pressure of cosmic strength.

final-summary.line_1: Darth Vader possesses technique and control that could kill almost any being, but Thanos operates on a different level of physics.
final-summary.line_2: Vader's destructive opening is but a test for the Titan's durability, which he passes without much difficulty.
final-summary.line_3: This is a clash of whether lightsaber precision can find a gap in armor that has survived galactic explosions.

tactical-board.lane: Vader must solve the fight fast. Thanos only needs one opening to fail.
tactical-board.subtitle: Sith Lord versus Titan

x-factor.implikacja: If Thanos survives the first real bypass, the fight immediately shifts onto his terms.
x-factor.mechanika: Vader can only win if the first surgical attempt truly bypasses Thanos's cosmic durability.
x-factor.psychologia: Vader wants a controlled duel. Thanos wants the fight to become a long execution.
